query:
SELECT 
  orderCode,
  orderType,
  COALESCE(purchasePriceUsd, 0) as purchasePrice,
  COALESCE(sellingPriceUsd, 0) as sellingPrice,
  COALESCE(itemPriceUsd, 0) as itemPrice,
  COALESCE(commissionFeeUsd, 0) as commissionFee,
  quantity,
  COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0) as shippingCost,
  COALESCE(profitUsd, 0) as profit,
  status,
  CASE 
    WHEN orderType = 'full_package' THEN CONCAT('Expected: (', sellingPriceUsd, ' - ', purchasePriceUsd, ') × ', quantity, ' - ', COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0), ' = ', ((sellingPriceUsd - purchasePriceUsd) * quantity - COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0)))
    WHEN orderType = 'purchase_request' THEN CONCAT('Expected: -', COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0))
    WHEN orderType = 'commission' THEN CONCAT('Expected: -', COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0))
  END as expectedCalculation
FROM fullPackageOrders 
WHERE orderCode IN ('FP-PROFIT-TEST-001', 'PR-PROFIT-TEST-002', 'COM-PROFIT-TEST-003')
ORDER BY orderCode;
